# FG-CI-0005

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 503 |
| 重大度 | alert |
| Runbook | [`ci-runner`](../../ops/runbooks/ci-runner.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `pending_jobs_without_a_live_runner_are_no_runner_available` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: CI のジョブを実行できる Runner がいません。管理者に連絡してください。
- en: No CI runner is available to run the jobs. Contact the administrator.
- id: Tidak ada runner CI yang tersedia untuk menjalankan tugas. Hubungi administrator.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C3 (plan 14 §6, §7): CI jobs have been `pending` longer than the wait limit (10 minutes) and no enabled runner whose tags cover them has claimed them: no runner is registered or enabled, every runner has stopped contacting forge (`last_contact_at` older than 5 minutes), or the jobs ask for tags (`tags:` in `.forge-ci.yml`) no enabled runner has. Jobs wait; nothing is lost.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

`forge worker` logs `forge.ci.no_runner_available` (error, at most once per 10 minutes) with `error_code`, `request_id`, `waiting` (how many jobs), `oldest_job_id`, `oldest_wait_s`, `enabled_runners` and `live_runners`. `forge doctor` `ci.runners` fails with this code and the same facts. Read: SELECT id, name, enabled, tags, last_contact_at FROM forge.ci_runners ORDER BY id; and SELECT id, pipeline_id, tags, created_at FROM forge.ci_jobs WHERE status = 'pending' ORDER BY id LIMIT 10;

## 対処 (fix)

Follow runbook ci-runner: start the runner process on its host, enable a disabled runner (PATCH /api/v1/admin/runners/{id} {"enabled": true}, an administrator's web session), or register a runner with the tags the jobs ask for.
